title: Bale Banjar Sokasi Cafe Ubud
address: Jl. Raya Kengetan, Singakerta, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali
description_id: Penayangan perdana di tanah Bali (Genesis Screening). Menghadirkan sesi berbagi langsung bersama Made Bayak dan Gus Dark.
description_en: Genesis screening in Bali. Featuring a live sharing session with Balinese artivists Made Bayak and Gus Dark.
review_id: Masyarakat dan seniman lokal Ubud menggarisbawahi pentingnya menjaga tanah air dan ekosistem subak dari ekspansi pariwisata yang tak terkendali.
review_en: Local Ubud residents and artists emphasized the urgency of protecting native lands and subak ecosystems from unchecked tourism expansion.
